blind.description: A square medieval dungeon hatch consisting of a border of eight carved grey stone blocks forming a rim around an open pit. Resting on top is a sturdy hinged metal bar grate finished in aged bronze or rusted iron, complete with cylindrical hinge pivots along one side, a latch with a padlock-ready hasp on the opposing edge, and a round pull ring for lifting.
blind.from_above: A square stone border surrounding a dark square aperture, covered by a barred metal gate hinged on the left with a circular pull ring in the upper-right corner and a fastening latch on the right side.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/5 as tall as the figure (roughly 1 to 1.2 ft high) and about 4 to 4.5 ft wide across each side (approximately 75% the height of the figure in width).

notes: Height is slightly taller than catalog due to pit interior beneath the kerb, but reads correctly as a low hatch
